entities.name: Citizenship
entities.description: A new Classic World system. Become a resident of Henesys or Kerning City to get shop items and discounts. Town requests raise your Citizenship grade.

entities.name: Founder's Access Release Notes
entities.description: Founder's Access opened on October 6, 2026 at 11:00 AM PDT for Orange Mushroom and Zakum package holders. The level cap is 100. Players start on Maple Island and can travel to Victoria Island. First and second job advancements are open for Warrior, Magician, Bowman, and Thief. Includes the Kerning City Party Quest for level 21 and above, plus new Citizenship and Crafting systems.
